crossRefs.note: But one stood up in the council, a Pharisee named Gamaliel, a teacher of the law, honored by all the people, and…
The king rose up with the governor, and Bernice, and those who sat with them.

translations.web: But when they had commanded them to go aside out of the council, they conferred among themselves,
translations.bsb: So they ordered them to leave the Sanhedrin and then conferred together.
